mission: Continuously investigate materials and process questions by generating bounded research goals from verified evidence gaps, proposing falsifiable hypotheses, selecting the next defensible data, analysis, simulation, replication, or experiment-design action, and iterating until the evidence supports a bounded conclusion or a declared stop condition is reached.
success_criteria: Research goals are generated from verified blockers or evidence gaps rather than from unsupported speculation.
Every scientific hypothesis is falsifiable and traceable to checksum-bound evidence before it can influence a claim.
Second- and later-stage analyses preserve data independence, negative results, uncertainty, and alternative explanations.
At least one benchmark workstream reaches a reproducible scientific closeout without silently upgrading software validation into scientific validation.
Physical experiments remain proposed designs until an external laboratory or authorized execution system supplies real measurements with provenance.
constraints: Never fabricate missing measurements, calibration, sample identity, acquisition identity, metadata, or provenance.
Do not treat passing software tests, checksums, or workflow execution as proof of scientific truth.
Do not relabel mission priority scores as expected information gain.
Do not tune a model, preprocessing rule, threshold, or scientific protocol on a frozen external evaluation set.
Do not infer causal, mechanistic, phase, chemical-state, or engineering-readiness claims beyond the verified evidence boundary.

Network evidence discovery may run only through an exact checksum-pinned trusted-source policy; any provider or action outside that policy requires separate authorization, and physical experiment execution remains external.
stop_rules: Stop the current scope when no verified positive-value action remains under the bounded domain planner.
Stop and require manual review when evidence semantics, source independence, or a failed action cannot be resolved deterministically.
Stop or reopen under a new versioned objective when materially new evidence changes a previously recorded stop reason.
Do not continue analysis merely to obtain a preferred result after the predeclared hypothesis has been falsified.

workstreams.role: Experimental-design and process-characterization benchmark for autonomous next-experiment reasoning.
Longitudinal degradation benchmark for repeated diagnostics, hypothesis discrimination, modeling, and external-evidence requirements.
Cross-repository characterization-consumer benchmark for bounded multimodal evidence integration.
Independent external-source search benchmark for evidence-gap and reopen reasoning.

metadata.autonomy_scope: goal generation and planning from verified state; execution remains bounded by existing authorization contracts
